deadly_aspects.name: Deadly Aspects
deadly_aspects.text: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, all normal ranged attacks have a 2% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 2% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

endurance_training.name: Endurance Training
endurance_training.text: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 3%.

focused_fire.name: Focused Fire
focused_fire.text: Increases all damage you deal by 1% while your pet is active.

improved_aspect_of_the_monkey.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
improved_aspect_of_the_monkey.text: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 2%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

pathfinding.name: Pathfinding
pathfinding.text: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 3%.

improved_revive_pet.name: Improved Revive Pet
improved_revive_pet.text: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 3 sec, mana cost is reduced by 20%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 15%.

bestial_swiftness.name: Bestial Swiftness
bestial_swiftness.text: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

unleashed_fury.name: Unleashed Fury
unleashed_fury.text: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 3%.

improved_mend_pet.name: Improved Mend Pet
improved_mend_pet.text: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 15% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 10%.

ferocity.name: Ferocity
ferocity.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 2%.

summon_hawk.name: Summon Hawk
summon_hawk.text: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 53 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

spirit_bond.name: Spirit Bond
spirit_bond.text: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 10 sec.

intimidation.name: Intimidation
intimidation.text: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

bestial_discipline.name: Bestial Discipline
bestial_discipline.text: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 10% and allows 25% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.text: Gives your pet a 20% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

bestial_wrath.name: Bestial Wrath
bestial_wrath.text: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

hawk_eye.name: Hawk Eye
hawk_eye.text: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 2 yards.

improved_concussive_shot.name: Improved Concussive Shot
improved_concussive_shot.text: Gives your Concussive Shot a 4% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

lethal_attacks.name: Lethal Attacks
lethal_attacks.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.

improved_stings.name: Improved Stings
improved_stings.text: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 6%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 2 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 15 sec.

efficiency.name: Efficiency
efficiency.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 3%.

careful_aim.name: Careful Aim
careful_aim.text: Increases your Attack Power by 20% of your Intellect.

rapid_killing.name: Rapid Killing
rapid_killing.text: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 1 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 10%.

improved_arcane_shot.name: Improved Arcane Shot
improved_arcane_shot.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 0.3 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

lone_wolf.name: Lone Wolf
lone_wolf.text: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

trueshot_aura.name: Trueshot Aura
trueshot_aura.text: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yards by 30. Lasts 30 min.

mortal_shots.name: Mortal Shots
mortal_shots.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 6%.

rapid_recuperation.name: Rapid Recuperation
rapid_recuperation.text: Hitting a target with your Serpent Sting ability grants you 25% and consuming Rapid Killing grants you 50% of your Mana regeneration while casting for the next 15 sec.

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.text: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 3%.

scatter_shot.name: Scatter Shot
scatter_shot.text: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

ranged_weapon_specialization.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
ranged_weapon_specialization.text: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 1%.

sniper_shot.name: Sniper Shot
sniper_shot.text: A steady snipe that increases ranged damage by 160.

improved_tracking.name: Improved Tracking
improved_tracking.text: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 1%.

entrapment.name: Entrapment
entrapment.text: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 1 sec.

savage_strikes.name: Savage Strikes
savage_strikes.text: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 2%.

improved_wing_clip.name: Improved Wing Clip
improved_wing_clip.text: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 7% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

clever_traps.name: Clever Traps
clever_traps.text: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 15% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 15%.

surefooted.name: Surefooted
surefooted.text: Increases your hit chance by 1% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 10%.

deterrence.name: Deterrence
deterrence.text: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

survival_tactics.name: Survival Tactics
survival_tactics.text: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 5%.

predator_s_edge.name: Predator's Edge
predator_s_edge.text: Increases your melee critical strike damage by 6% and your offhand weapon damage by 10%.

counterattack.name: Counterattack
counterattack.text: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 13 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

resourcefulness.name: Resourcefulness
resourcefulness.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Trap abilities and melee abilities by 30%. In addition, your critical strikes have a 30% chance to allow 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.

expose_prey.name: Expose Prey
expose_prey.text: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 5% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 5 sec.

survivalist_s_discipline.name: Survivalist's Discipline
survivalist_s_discipline.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 20%.

strider_kick.name: Strider Kick
strider_kick.text: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage.

lacerating_strikes.name: Lacerating Strikes
lacerating_strikes.text: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage over 21 sec equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite.
